definitions.explanation: Numerical data collected and analyzed to reveal patterns or trends. Also refers to the field of study dealing with such data.

examples.japanese: {統計|とうけい}によると、{日本|にほん}の{人口|じんこう}は{減少|げんしょう}している。
examples.english: According to statistics, Japan's population is decreasing.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}の{統計|とうけい}を{取|と}る。
{統計|とうけい}{学|がく}を{専攻|せんこう}しています。

notes:
USAGE: {統計|とうけい} refers to both statistical data and the academic field of statistics.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {統計|とうけい}を{取|と}る (to compile statistics)
- {統計|とうけい}によると (according to statistics)
- {統計|とうけい}{的|てき}に (statistically)
- {統計|とうけい}{調査|ちょうさ} (statistical survey)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {統計|とうけい}{学|がく} (statistics - academic field)
- {統計|とうけい}{データ} (statistical data)
- {統計|とうけい}{資料|しりょう} (statistical materials)
- {人口|じんこう}{統計|とうけい} (population statistics)
